GM G+ Compact Universal Charger Travel Adapter – One Plug for 150+ Countries

The GM G+ Compact Universal Charger Travel Adapter is designed for modern travelers who need a reliable, safe, and space-saving charging solution anywhere in the world. This Universal All-in-One Worldwide Plug (US/UK/EU/AU) supports seamless charging across more than 150+ countries, making it an essential travel accessory for international trips, business travel, vacations, and digital nomads.

Built with smart safety protection and a fire-resistant body, this adapter ensures safe and stable power delivery for all your essential devices. Whether you are charging smartphones, laptops, tablets, cameras, power banks, or Bluetooth accessories, the multi-device charging capability allows you to stay powered without carrying multiple adapters.

Universal Compatibility for Global Travel

The features an advanced universal plug system compatible with US, UK, EU, and AU sockets. It works flawlessly in popular travel destinations across Asia, Europe, America, Australia, Africa, and the Middle East. This worldwide travel eliminates the hassle of buying country-specific plugs, making it a perfect companion for frequent flyers.

  • Supports US, UK, EU & AU plug standards
  • Compatible with sockets in 150+ countries

Multi-Device Charging with Smart Safety Protection

Designed for convenience and safety, this compact universal travel charger allows you to charge multiple devices efficiently. The built-in smart safety protection guards against over-current, over-voltage, overheating, and short circuits, ensuring reliable performance even during extended use.

The fire-resistant travel charger housing adds an extra layer of protection, making it safe for hotel rooms, airports, offices, and homes. You can confidently charge your devices without worrying about electrical hazards.

  • Smart protection against voltage fluctuations
  • Fire-resistant and heat-safe construction
  • Stable power output for sensitive electronics
  • Safe for continuous and overnight charging
